classes.name: Tip rack
classes.description: A pipette tip rack occupies the slot, with or without tips. Transparent or partially obscured racks qualify only when visible structural features unambiguously identify a tip rack and its slot.
classes.exclude: Tube racks and microplates. Tip count is irrelevant. Uncertain identity, slot assignment, or ambiguous stacks require manual review.

classes.name: Microplate
classes.description: A well plate occupies the slot, including PCR or deep-well plates. Transparent or partially obscured plates qualify only when visible well and plate structure unambiguously establishes identity and slot assignment.
classes.exclude: Tip racks and reservoirs. Glare, occlusion, or stacks that make identity or slot assignment ambiguous require manual review.

classes.name: Reservoir
classes.description: A reagent reservoir occupies the slot. Transparent or partially obscured reservoirs qualify only when visible walls and compartment structure unambiguously establish identity and slot assignment; liquid visibility alone is insufficient.
classes.exclude: Microplates, waste containers, and empty slots. Uncertain identity, slot assignment, or ambiguous stacks require manual review.

classes.name: Tube rack
classes.description: A rack for individual tubes occupies the slot. Transparent or partially obscured racks qualify only when visible rack structure unambiguously establishes identity and slot assignment.
classes.exclude: Pipette tip racks and well plates. Uncertain identity, slot assignment, or ambiguous stacks require manual review.

classes.name: Other labware
classes.description: Clearly identifiable labware occupies the slot and demonstrably falls outside the other defined labware classes. Transparent items qualify only when sufficient structure is visible to make that determination.
classes.exclude: Not a fallback for uncertain identity. Obscured or ambiguous views, uncertain slot assignments, ambiguous stacks, and hardware modules require manual review.

labelPolicy: Visible silhouette boxes, normalized xywh; fewer than 64 pixels or under 25% visibility holds the entire frame for review. Transparent labware is treated as solid for labeling; acrylic is ignored as an occluder. Labware classes exclude empty. Complete twelve-slot observed states are in deck-state JSON; separate slots/ labels classify occupied, empty, obscured, unknown. No off-camera boxes are invented. Scene truth is separate from observation. Legacy frames are held for review.
splitPolicy: Whole runs stay in their assigned split. Keep related reruns in the same split; evaluate against separately labeled real camera images.

classifier.name: Labware & deck occupancy
classifier.objective: Identify labware occupying each visible Flex deck slot. Label transparent labware only when its structure is identifiable; label empty only when the entire slot footprint is verifiably unoccupied. Route ambiguous, obscured, or unsupported views to manual review rather than forcing a class. Split data by capture session to prevent leakage.

feedback: Expand training diversity for fixed-camera YOLO deck detection. Keep pan 10 tilt 40 zoom 1 exposure 1 warmth 0. Generate 3 scenes per batch. Balance tip rack, plate and reservoir instances across EVERY usable slot A1 A2 B1 B2 B3 C1 C2 C3 D1 D2 D3, especially rear slots and partial visibility at edges. Use all available model variants including 10 uL tips and deep-well plates. Vary occupancy from 1 to 8 objects, sometimes 0. Use nonzero yaw and offsets within limits. Include adjacent tall racks obscuring shorter transparent labware. Avoid repeating prior layouts. A3 waste stays fixed. No camera sweep. Aim for balanced per-slot and per-class coverage, not many identical empty decks.

Use 8 varied scenes per batch now, overriding the earlier 3-scene request. Keep camera pan 10 tilt 40 zoom 1 and matched lighting. Balance all three supported classes and all nine asset variants across all usable deck slots. Vary offsets and yaw within allowed bounds. Include 0, 1, 2, 4, 6 and 8 occupied slots; empty scenes only 5% of images. Include tall objects adjacent to clear plates and reservoirs. Prioritize unique nonempty layouts.

Real-camera baseline errors: bare A1/B1 foreground silver deck plates were mistaken for Microplate, and translucent deep-well plate B2 was missed. Prioritize hard negatives: ~15% empty decks and many sparse 1–2 object layouts leaving A1 B1 C1 silver deck exposed. Ensure NEST deep-96 at B2 often, also A1 A2 B1 B3 C1 C2 C3 D1 D2 D3. Do not copy the current physical arrangement exclusively; preserve coverage and all classes. Use 8 scenes per batch. Fixed calibrated view and lighting.

Live diagnostic found yellow tip racks at C2 and D2 but missed a partly hidden, cropped NEST 12-channel reservoir at D3 behind D2. Add edge-occlusion examples at D3/C3 with reservoirs and plates, as well as empty slots and other classes there. Keep all previous class/slot coverage, 8 varied scenes per batch, 15% empty scenes, and fixed calibrated camera and lighting.

The live robot gantry occludes the deck while operating. For HALF of remaining scenes vary the simulated gantry using the new gantry field: x across -0.28..0.24 m, y across -0.10..0.22 m, z across 0..0.12 m. The other half use gantry:null (parked saved pose). Keep the camera pan10 tilt40 zoom1 and lighting fixed. Use 8 scenes per batch. Balance all three classes and all nine assets/slots, including cropped D3 reservoirs behind D2 tip racks and empty/other-class D3 alternatives. Keep 15% empty decks. Important: these gantry values are simulation only, never physical hardware.
